Accessibility Statement

Tonyana, the Subconscious Specialist LLC is committed to making this website usable by everyone, including people with disabilities.

Our Commitment

We want everyone who visits this website to be able to learn about our services and get in touch. We work to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at Level AA, the standard published by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).

Conformance Status

Based on our most recent review, this website partially conforms with WCAG 2.1 Level AA. Partially conforms means that some parts of the content do not fully meet the standard. Those parts are listed below under Known Limitations.

Accessibility Features

  • A "Skip to content" link at the top of every page for keyboard and screen reader users.
  • Every link, button, and form field can be reached and used with a keyboard, including the site menu. When the menu opens, focus moves into it, and the Escape key closes it.
  • A visible focus indicator shows where you are: an outline on links and buttons, and a highlighted border on form fields.
  • A "Pause animations" button stops the moving stars, the rotating client quotes, and other animations. Your choice is remembered as you move between pages.
  • Animations are paused automatically if your device is set to reduce motion.
  • Text, form fields, and focus outlines meet WCAG color contrast requirements.
  • Pages can be zoomed, and they fit screens as narrow as 320 pixels without scrolling sideways.
  • Headings, page landmarks, and labeled form fields help screen reader users find their way around each page.
  • Meaningful images have text descriptions, and decorative images are hidden from screen readers.
  • Links that open in a new tab say so to screen reader users.

Known Limitations

Some parts of this website are provided by other companies, and we cannot fully control their accessibility:

  • Messages from our contact form are delivered by a third-party service. After you send a message, that service may ask you to complete a CAPTCHA, which can be difficult for some people to use. If that happens, please email us directly at libratarot@hotmail.com.
  • Our Facebook and Instagram pages are hosted by those platforms and follow their own accessibility practices.

How We Tested

We assessed this website ourselves using automated accessibility tools (Google Lighthouse and axe-core) and browser-based checks of keyboard navigation, focus order, color contrast, reduced-motion settings, and small-screen layouts.

Feedback and Assistance

If you have trouble using any part of this website, or need information in a different format, please let us know. Tell us which page you were on and what went wrong, and we will respond within 5 business days.

  • Email: libratarot@hotmail.com
  • Or use the form on our contact page.

Statement Date

This statement was last reviewed on November 9, 2026.
